evals.name: install-on-mac
evals.prompt: I need autopilot-preflight installed on my Mac.
evals.expected_output: Checks if already installed, detects macOS platform, lists release assets to find versioned filename, downloads binary + checksum, verifies SHA-256, installs to ~/.local/bin, clears quarantine, confirms version

assertions.text: Checks whether autopilot-preflight is already installed via --version before downloading
Detects OS and architecture automatically via uname, does not ask the user
Lists release assets to discover the versioned filename before downloading (does not hardcode a filename pattern without the version)
Downloads both the binary and the .sha256 checksum file
Verifies the SHA-256 checksum before installing
Clears macOS quarantine with xattr -d com.apple.quarantine on Darwin
Runs autopilot-preflight --version to confirm installation succeeded

evals.name: install-without-gh-cli
evals.prompt: I need to install autopilot-preflight but I don't have the gh CLI tool. Can you help?
evals.expected_output: Falls back to curl against the GitHub Releases API, still verifies checksum, completes the install without gh

assertions.text: Does not attempt to use gh commands when the user says gh is unavailable
Uses curl to fetch the latest release tag from the GitHub API
Downloads both the binary and the .sha256 checksum file via curl
Verifies the SHA-256 checksum before installing
Completes the full install procedure (chmod, install to ~/.local/bin, verify --version)

evals.name: install-on-linux
evals.prompt: Set up autopilot-preflight on my Ubuntu server.
evals.expected_output: Detects Linux x86_64, downloads the linux-amd64 binary, verifies checksum, does NOT attempt xattr quarantine clearing

assertions.text: Detects Linux platform and selects the linux-amd64 or linux-arm64 artifact suffix
Does NOT run xattr -d com.apple.quarantine on Linux
Verifies the SHA-256 checksum before installing
Provides the correct shell rc file for bash (bashrc or profile) if PATH needs updating
